name: spinning-text
title: Spinning Text
description: Text laid out around a circle that rotates continuously.
usage:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { SpinningText } from '@/components/ui/spinning-text'
</script>

<template>
  <SpinningText>learn more • earn more • grow more •</SpinningText>
</template>

props.name: text
props.description: The text to place around the circle. Falls back to the text of the default slot.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds for one full rotation. The text stays still when the user prefers reduced motion.

props.name: variants
props.description: Custom variants for the container and for each letter.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Plain text to place around the circle, used when the `text` prop is not set.
